function.name: SQL_QueryReadonly
function.description: Execute SELECT queries on the finance database to retrieve financial data, company information, and analytics. Only read-only SELECT statements are allowed for security.

statement.description: SQL SELECT statement to execute. Must start with SELECT and cannot contain data modification operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, etc.). Example: 'SELECT * FROM companies WHERE sector = "Technology"'

function.name: SQL_GetSchema
function.description: Get database schema information including table structures, column details, and relationships

function.name: SQL_GetSampleQueries
function.description: Get sample SQL queries for exploring the financial database
